name: Breadcrumbs
description: Shows where the user is and links back up the hierarchy.

children.description: Breadcrumb items (use Breadcrumbs.Item); the last one is the current page

maxItems.description: The most items to show; past it, the items after the first fold into one menu (needs at least 2)

when: Nested content more than two levels deep
Jumping back to a parent in one click
whenNot: Flat structures with no parents (use Tabs or header navigation)
guidelines: End on the current page: the last item, never a link
Short labels — the trail is a path, not a summary
Set maxItems to fold long paths into one menu, keeping the first item and the tail
Pass render for router links; href renders a plain link
Set label to rename the landmark (defaults to "Breadcrumb")
Crumbs truncate at 192px so one long title cannot push the rest out
accessibility: The last item is marked with aria-current="page" and is not a link
Separators sit inside each item and are hidden from screen readers
The fold is a menu button named "Show collapsed breadcrumbs"; its crumbs are menu links

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Each ancestor links; the last one is the current page.

examples.name: Collapsed
examples.description: Past maxItems, the items after the first fold into one menu.
examples.code:
<Breadcrumbs maxItems={3}>
  <Breadcrumbs.Item href="#">Home</Breadcrumbs.Item>
  <Breadcrumbs.Item href="#">Category</Breadcrumbs.Item>
  <Breadcrumbs.Item href="#">Subcategory</Breadcrumbs.Item>
  <Breadcrumbs.Item href="#">Section</Breadcrumbs.Item>
  <Breadcrumbs.Item>Current page</Breadcrumbs.Item>
</Breadcrumbs>

examples.name: Router Links
examples.description: render makes the crumb your router's link.

examples.name: Custom Landmark Label
examples.description: Renames the landmark screen readers announce.

relations.note: Use Tabs for flat, non-hierarchical navigation
Breadcrumbs complement sidebar navigation for deep hierarchies

propsSummary: maxItems: number - fold the items after the first into one menu
Breadcrumbs.Item href: string - makes the item a link
Breadcrumbs.Item render: ReactElement - renders the crumb as this element (router links)
Breadcrumbs.Item onClick: function - a button crumb when there is no href or render
The last Breadcrumbs.Item is the current page (aria-current, not a link)
